title: "It disappears": Historian Peter Levenda reveals UFO encounter "right over" his car in Florida
excerpt: In the past few decades, there have been innumerable instances of people having UFO encounters, which has made them curious about extraterrestrial life.
content:
In the past few decades, there have been innumerable instances of people having UFO encounters, which has made them curious about extraterrestrial life. With recent whistleblowers claiming that non-human intelligence has in fact made contact with us but that governments are keeping it from us, curiosity about extraterrestrial life is at its peak.

Now, historian and author, Peter Levenda has talked about his own UFO encounter and how he broke it down for better understanding.

UFO files: Peter Levenda's experience with extraterrestrial life

Peter Levenda is an author, historian, and researcher who writes on occult history, secret societies, intelligence operations, and ufology. Some of his most notable works include Sinister Forces Trilogy, Ratline, and Sekret Machines Series. In a recent episode of Mayim Bialik’s Breakdown, historian and author, Peter Levenda, talked about UFOs, nonhuman intelligence, and UAP, among other topics.

Peter Levenda recalled that one night during a December, while driving home in South Florida, he thought he saw a police helicopter hovering in the sky. What was strange is that as Levenda said, whatever was in the sky was ''right over'' his car. He said that he had stopped the car and looked up, only to realize that it was not a police helicopter.

Levenda explained that he tried to consider every possible explanation, initially thinking it could be an aircraft he did not recognize and tried to use his rational mind to examine all the possibilities before arriving at the obvious conclusion that he was looking at a UFO. He then said:

''It disappears''

He said that the object suddenly took off and disappeared without making any sound or showing any visible acceleration. Levenda said that while he could explain the object's shape and what exactly happened to him, he didn't have an explanation for it.

He did clarify that it was not some divine intervention or a triangle containing the eye of God; it was simply a triangle. He concluded that this was the extent of his experience and wondered whether he could use the information for something or whether anyone would be interested in it, as he felt he did not have enough evidence.

Levenda and host Mayim Bialik then talked about the possible reasons as to why he and others like him experience such UFO encounters while others don't. They explored the possibility that perhaps some individuals are able to summon these objects or experiences while others cannot.

Bialik suggested that perhaps Levenda had the experience he did because he spends a lot of his time reading and writing about extraterrestrial life and secret societies, among others of the like. She suggested that perhaps being surrounded by all these energies made Levenda sensitive to non-human intelligence, and he in a way summoned it. Levenda agreed, saying he thinks that could be a possibility.

However, there is no proof that what Levenda saw was a UFO. So far, there have been reports of people experiencing similar encounters, but none of them have been proved to be evidence of extraterrestrial life. Curiosity and research regarding this is ongoing, and perhaps we'll soon know more.
